🫏 New post ready 📖 Story · siblings · 6 slides “you handed me the dry tea towel without looking up from the roasting pan.” 📝 Slides
1. you handed me the dry tea towel without looking up from the roasting pan. 2. you always took the wash basin, telling me i was too clumsy with the hot tap. 3. so for ten years i stood by the drainer, complaining about every greasy fork. 4. but tonight you stayed at the sink while the water went cold around your wrists. 5. you said you only took the wash side so the boiling water would never burn my hands. 6. i dried the last chipped mug three times, just so i didn't have to leave the room.
✍️ Caption
you took the rougher half of every chore and made it sound like an insult so i wouldn't notice. send this to the brother or sister who always took the hot water first. #siblings #siblinglove #growingupwithsiblings #oldersiblings
